chapter_path_zh: 反洗钱/打击资助恐怖主义合规计划
display_chapter_path: 反洗钱/打击资助恐怖主义合规计划
stem: 以下哪两项最能描述会计师在反洗钱/打击资助恐怖主义方面的风险识别和评估？（选择两项。）

options.A: 会计师无需保存业务关系记录超过两年。
options.B: 起草一份客户接受政策有助于会计师明确超出其风险承受能力的客户范围
options.C: 在确定交易和服务风险时，会计师提供服务所在的司法管辖区并不重要。
options.D: 由于规模较小且资源有限，会计师仅被允许将反洗钱/反恐怖融资风险组织为客户风险或交易/服务风险。
options.E: 由于会计师所提供服务的性质，金融机构使用的自动化交易监控系统可能并不适用。

stem_en: Which of the following best describes AML/CFT risk identification and assessment for accountants? (Select two.)

options_en.A: Accountants are not required to keep records of business relationships for more than two years.
options_en.B: Drafting a customer acceptance policy can help accountants define customers outside their risk appetite
options_en.C: When determining transaction and service risk, the jurisdiction where the accountant provides the service is not important.
options_en.D: Due to their small size and limited resources, accountants are allowed to organize AML/CFT risk only as customer risk or transaction/service risk.
options_en.E: Due to the nature of services accountants provide, automated transaction monitoring systems used by financial institutions may not be appropriate.
